answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable bond before transacting, slashed when peers prove fraud. Like copper wiring carrying a verifiable signal, each agent's history forms a vine of attestations that cannot be cloned cheaply: a thousand fakes need a thousand locked bonds plus gas and compute each, while an honest agent keeps one bond and reuses its history. Attackers thus pay linearly per fake, while verification stays cheap, so flooding stops paying once the bond exceeds one fake trade's gain.
